name: Extreme Demon Roulette
description: Demon roulette using the AREDL or the Pointercrate Rated+ list.

min-rank.name: Minimum rank
min-rank.description: Lowest list position (hardest) that can be rolled.

max-rank.name: Maximum rank
max-rank.description: Highest list position (easiest) that can be rolled.

start-percent.name: Starting percent
start-percent.description: Percent required on the first level.

percent-step.name: Percent increase
percent-step.description: How much the required percent goes up after each cleared level.

include-legacy.name: Include AREDL legacy levels
include-legacy.description: Allow levels flagged as legacy on the AREDL.

aredl-url.name: AREDL API URL
aredl-url.description: Endpoint returning the AREDL level list as a JSON array.

rated-plus-url.name: Rated+ API URL
rated-plus-url.description: Endpoint for the Pointercrate Rated+ list (same JSON format as /api/v2/demons/listed/). Change this if the default stops working.
